## Reproductive models

Both temperature formulations appear in the main analysis. The single-temperature model estimates one temperature association; the within–between model replaces it with separate within-female and between-female terms. The complete formulas and scripts are on the [clutch](clutch_size.qmd), [fledging](fledging_success.qmd) and [within–between](within_between.qmd) pages.

| Response | Distribution and components | Random intercepts |
|---|---|---|
| Clutch size | Mean-parameterised COM-Poisson; predictors enter log mean and log inverse shape | Female and year in mean |
| Egg-to-fledging success | Zero-inflated beta-binomial; predictors enter component logit mean and log precision | Female and year in mean; year in precision and extra-zero probability |
| Calendar-year trends | Same response distributions as above, with temperature removed from location and scale | Retained from corresponding reproductive model |

Fitting requires curated individual records and saved starting objects. These are not included in the public repository, so model fitting is done locally in the recorded R/glmmTMB environment. The complete code is available as downloadable R scripts on the analysis pages.

## Spring-temperature model

The environmental model is a Gaussian location–scale fit to the 46 annual mean temperatures. Calendar year enters both the mean and log standard deviation. This light model can be rerun in the browser from the public annual file:

{{< include _includes/lab-04_environment_model.qmd >}}

The fitted warming trend was 0.0439°C per year (95% CI 0.0248–0.0630); residual interannual variability showed no clear temporal change.

## Fit diagnostics

Saved optimizer and conditional-simulation outputs are shown below. Simulation checks condition on fitted parameters and group effects; they are descriptive checks, not cross-validation.

| Model | Records | logLik | AIC | Converged | Positive-definite Hessian |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| Clutch, temperature | 12,627 | −13,768.55 | 27,561.10 | yes | yes |
| Fledging, temperature | 9,790 | −16,632.06 | 33,294.11 | yes | yes |
| Clutch, no temperature | 12,627 | −13,776.52 | 27,573.04 | yes | yes |
| Fledging, no temperature | 9,790 | −16,638.42 | 33,302.84 | yes | yes |

## Within–between model comparison

| Trait | Single-temperature AIC | Within–between AIC | ΔAIC | Likelihood-ratio p |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Clutch size | 27,561.10 | 27,556.80 | −4.31 | 0.0157 |
| Egg-to-fledging success | 33,294.11 | 33,297.87 | +3.75 | 0.885 |

The comparison adds two fixed effects and tests whether within- and between-female temperature associations differ in location and scale together. Full coefficient and optimizer outputs are on the [within–between results page](within_between.qmd).
